title: The part window's confirmation names the part as typed in the form
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test, with a description, description 1.
  • Use a new description, description 2, that no part uses.
  • Create an inactive part, part B, for this test, with a description, description 3.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Replace the Description with three spaces, description 2 and three spaces.
  4. Click Inactive under Part Status.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click Cancel in the confirmation.
  7. Click Cancel.
  8. Click the Inactive tab.
  9. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box again.
  10. Click the part B row.
  11. Click Active under Part Status.
  12. Click Save.
  13. Click Cancel in the confirmation.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 3:

  • Description holds the spaces and description 2.

Step 4:

  • Inactive is picked.

Step 5:

  • The confirmation is titled "Deactivate part?" and its first line is part A's part number followed by description 2, without the spaces, not the saved description 1.

Step 6:

  • The confirmation closes.

Step 7:

  • The window closes without saving: part A keeps description 1 and stays active.

Step 8:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 9:

  • Part B is listed.

Step 10:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part B.

Step 11:

  • Active is picked.

Step 12:

  • The confirmation is titled "Activate part?" and its first line is part B's part number followed by description 3.

Step 13:

  • The confirmation closes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-R4: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation opens with "{n} parts selected.", or "1 part selected." for one. Raised from the part dialog, it opens with the part number followed by the description, as they stand in the form, with spaces before and after removed.”
  • S10-R3: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation is titled "Deactivate parts?" or "Activate parts?". Raised from the part dialog, it is titled "Deactivate part?" or "Activate part?".”
  • S10-N1: “If the user cancels the confirmation, no part changes status.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
